{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {duplicate_count}")

# Check assay_batch distribution
batch_dist = df['assay_batch'].value_counts()
print(f"Assay batch distribution:\n{batch_dist}")

# Check if any patient has >1 sample_seq
retest_count = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count().gt(1).sum()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {retest_count}")

# Confirm that sample_seq is 1 or 2 only
print(f"Unique sample_seq values: {df['sample_seq'].unique()}")"}
